reviews.review:
I have been looking for a game along the lines of Gunfire Reborn and this is the first I have found that fits the bill. It has a good atmosphere, interesting gameplay choices, a nice graphical style and is well executed. It is fun to play and the progression/unlock options are well thought out. I like that the jumping puzzles, which are a small part of the game, are not too intrusive or difficult.

Unlike Gunfire Reborn, this game as at Oct 2020 is nowhere near complete. There are few levels and bosses and the gameplay is a little repetitive. I see my purchase as supporting the development team to finish what is promising to be a great game. But if you are sensitive to cost or risk, it is a bit expensive for what you get currently.

It's a simple FPS, speed ball style run and gun with roguelite elements. The gun play is responsive and satisfying. Movement is slick and intuitive. The sound track is high energy. Progression is good and the weapons are fun and feel just right. I'm really digging the art style too, it has that comic book-esque look with pronounced black outlines. I bought this because i can see the potential and the gameplay as-is justifies the purchase. The devs are active and listen to the community with a content road map. At this time there isn't much content unfortunately, as far as levels there are 3 unique areas and a dozen or so standard enemies as well as two bosses.

Gun-play feel: Nice 
Soundtrack: Jammin
Movement: Tight
Replayability: High
General quality: High
Enemy variety: Decent
Number of guns: Decently high (no bs 'same-gun, different-stats')
Visuals: Clean and pretty + fun
Boss battles: Fun

Lengthier write-up from another:
https://stitch.games/news/preview-roboquest/
pretty fun roguelite with lots of future potential, check it out and support the devs

The game is an amazing FPS. I would go on about the features and whatnot, but i am going to cut to the chase. I would really enjoy to have achievements. Examples of achievement goals and names :
Flyswatter : Destroy 100 drones.
Minesweeper : Blow up 100 mines with gunfire.
Ka-Boom! : Blow up 5 robots with one explosion.
Superb Robot : Get an S rank.
Mr. Perfect : Complete a run without taking damage.
Shiny! : Get an artifact.
Flying Threat : Stay airborne for 10 consecutive seconds.
Cozy Base : Build all upgrades for your base.
Sorry about the long list. Just a suggestion.
